messages:
tess: FYI our ricochet-13B int8 onboarding run surfaced repeated OOMs when clients send long history + generation. opening a thread to capture quick triage notes.
omar: seen it on the dashboards. pattern: requests with history >3k tokens, batch 5, gen cap 192. OOMs spike at token generation step when KV writes back.
leo: allocator stats? are we seeing many tiny frees?
tess: host snippet: ```CUDA_ERROR_OOM during alloc
GPU total 80GB, used 79.1GB, free 0.9GB
KV cache approx 62GB
Slab fragments: 980 small segments (~<32KB)
Request: history 3300 + gen 192 -> 3492 tokens
Batch size 5```
omar: int8 packing changed alignment and increased per-layer small allocations. combination with our slab allocator causes non-compacting holes.
leo: mitigation ideas: 1) reduce hosted default max_new_tokens for ricochet-int8 to 96 2) enable a "small-alloc-aggregation" path in allocator 3) dynamic microbatching for high-context requests.
tess: quick experiment results: dynamic microbatching (split large-history requests to per-item generation) + small-alloc-aggregation cut highwater by ~20GB on our sim set. p50 latency +4%, p95 +16% on heavy histories.
omar: quality check: do we see eval regressions with int8? on our long-summary eval set, ROUGE-L delta ~-0.7 vs fp16. small but customers notice.
leo: routing policy suggestion: mark /v1/summarize as "quality_protected" and prefer fp16 for that route. default still serves int8 for general chat.
tess: pragmatic rollout plan: - set ricochet/int8 hosted default max_new_tokens=96 (canary) - flip allocator small-agg in canary runtime - enable dynamic microbatch for requests with context_estimate>2500 - tag summarize routes to prefer fp16 fallback - run 48h soak with mixed-length corpus
omar: add alerts: frag_ratio > 0.3 or OOM count > 0.02% triggers rollback. also add eval check: ROUGE-L drift >0.5 triggers auto-fallback for that route.
ci-bot: canary deployment triggered: ricochet-13b:int8 flags=[max_new_tokens=96,small_agg_alloc=on,dyn_microbatch=on]; target=eng-staging; started=2026-03-25T11:03Z
leo: follow-ups: document recommended per-route snippet for customers who want long-context on Dedicated (suggest fp16 profile or explicit high-context quota). open ticket to prototype background KV compaction during low-load windows to reduce long-term fragmentation.
tess: I'll open the PR with config diffs and the eval snapshot. collecting logs for the soak. closing unless we see more OOMs. :white_check_mark:
